text:
Asha: Quick thread  tiny pricing experiment before next week's webinar. goal = reduce friction with a slim grid + email-quote flow + micro-FAQ.
Miguel: solid. what's the one-sentence hypothesis?
Asha: simpler visuals + immediate estimate -> higher demo clicks and more MQLs from mid-market.
Riley: propose two label variants: V1 descriptive (Launch / Scale / Secure) and V2 persona (Engineer / Product / Platform). pick one for A/B.
Priya: routing detail: email-quote submissions add hidden fields `experiment=slim_grid_may` and `lead_route=webinar_email`. HubSpot should tag contacts with `experiment=slim_grid_may`.
Levi (sales-bot): note: I will create a HS task when `lead_score>=60` and post to #sales-inbound with `experiment` tag. confirm threshold.
Dana: micro-FAQ (collapsed): 1) "How are tokens billed?" 2) "Can I reserve capacity?" 3) "Is data private?" answers one-line + learn more links.
Miguel: estimator variants: InlineEstimate (tokens/month input, instant ballpark, no email) vs EmailQuote (asks email + company size, sends quote). both client-only.
Priya: tracking: add `utm_experiment=slim_grid_may`, events `estimate_open`, `estimate_run`, `quote_request`, and GA cohort. split traffic 50/50.
Riley: accessibility: ensure inputs have labels, keyboard friendly sliders, modal traps focus.
Asha: timeline: copy freeze today EOD, dev Wed, QA Thu, soft launch Fri 10% traffic, ramp Monday.
Dana: ACTIONS: Asha finalize copy, Miguel build estimator, Priya map HubSpot fields, Riley wire accessibility checks, Levi test HS task creation.
Levi (sales-bot): smoke test scheduled  I'll report results to #marketing-ops.
Asha: thanks  unless objections i'll push to staging tonight. :rocket:
